subject: general
question: Severe undernutrition due to the deficiency of food and energy is termed as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**marasmus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Marasmus** is a severe form of undernutrition caused by a deficiency of calories and energy.
 
• It primarily affects young children and is characterized by significant weight loss, muscle wasting, and depletion of fat stores.
 
• Marasmus res
